summary: Tracks the consistency of every external directory that lists MarketNow. An agent that discovers MarketNow via an external directory should see the same honest positioning as on marketnow.site.

canonical_source_of_truth.payment: USDC on Base (chainId 8453) only — NOT ETH/BSC/SOL/BTC
canonical_source_of_truth.positioning: Trust layer for agent commerce (NOT 'largest marketplace')
canonical_source_of_truth.maintainer: AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2025), founder Edison Flores
canonical_source_of_truth.note: Our agent.json is the canonical source. Any external listing that contradicts it is stale.

listings.name: npm (marketnow-mcp)
what_we_fixed: v1.2.0: description said '9,248+ verified skills' → now says '9,248 MCP-compatible skills'
v1.3.0: added 'trust layer for agent commerce' positioning
v1.4.0: description now includes 'Sentinel L2, x402 (USDC on Base), AP2 mandates, AliceLabs LLC'

listings.name: Smithery

listings.notes: Smithery quality score: 84/100. Listing should reflect current data once Smithery re-crawls our server-card.json. Their cache TTL is typically 24-48h.

listings.name: mcp.so
known_discrepancies: Listing says '9,248 verified MCP-compatible skills' — should be 9,248
Listing says 'agent-to-agent crypto payments (ETH/BSC/SOL/BTC)' — we only support USDC on Base, NOT ETH/BSC/SOL/BTC directly
Listing says 'open registry with no manual approval needed' — we removed this framing; human-in-loop is now the default for mandates
Listing says 'largest open MCP skill marketplace' — we no longer claim to be the largest; we position as the trust layer
Listing says 'MIT license' — actual license is MNNC-1.0 (source-available, non-commercial)
actions_taken: Opened GitHub issue #2977 on chatmcp/mcpso repo requesting listing update: https://github.com/chatmcp/mcpso/issues/2977
Created /.well-known/mcp-marketplace.json with canonical metadata any scraper can pull
Updated GitHub repo README with canonical metadata table for crawlers
mcp.so is behind Cloudflare anti-bot protection — cannot be updated programmatically
Listing owner must update manually via mcp.so dashboard (requires login as @edgarfloresguerra2011-a11y)
listings.notes: mcp.so is operated by chatmcp (GitHub: chatmcp/mcpso). The directory is open source — listings appear to be added/updated via GitHub issues or dashboard edit. We opened issue #2977 requesting the update. The listing owner (Edison Flores) has not yet logged in to mcp.so to edit the listing directly.

listings.name: Official MCP Registry
listings.notes: We are not yet registered in the official MCP registry. Registration requires namespace verification via GitHub OAuth or DNS — see /standards. Once registered, our listing there will be the canonical source of truth that other directories can pull from.

commitment: We will maintain this page as the canonical source of truth for which external listings are current vs stale.
When we cannot update an external listing directly, we will disclose the discrepancy here rather than pretend it does not exist.
If you find a listing that contradicts our actual capabilities, email info@alicelabs.site and we will investigate and document it here.
The official MCP registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) will be our canonical listing once we complete namespace verification.
